scripts.build: npm run build:camps && npm run build:platform
scripts.typegen: wrangler types --strict-vars=false && wrangler types --strict-vars=false -c platform/wrangler.jsonc --env-interface PlatformEnv platform/worker-configuration.d.ts && react-router typegen && react-router typegen platform
scripts.deploy: npm run config:hosted && npm run build && npx tsx scripts/check-deploy-target.ts production && wrangler deploy && cd platform && wrangler deploy
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run config:hosted && CLOUDFLARE_ENV=staging npm run build && npx tsx scripts/check-deploy-target.ts staging && wrangler deploy && cd platform && wrangler deploy
scripts.postinstall: npm run config:local && wrangler types --strict-vars=false && wrangler types --strict-vars=false -c platform/wrangler.jsonc --env-interface PlatformEnv platform/worker-configuration.d.ts
scripts.test:postmark: TEST_EMAIL_PROVIDER=postmark vitest run tests/email tests/auth tests/people tests/join tests/feedback tests/platform tests/jobs tests/ops
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
